description.value: Colbourne House is a 1912 heritage building on Southwest Marine Drive that has served as the home of the Marpole Museum & Historical Society since 2005. The volunteer-run museum preserves the history of one of Vancouver's oldest neighbourhoods, whose Indigenous settlement dates back to roughly 3500 BC. Touring cyclists on the SW Marine Drive corridor will find a small but characterful community museum in a quiet residential setting.
